title: A truncated carrier is refused by the decoder
teaches: PACB is a self-describing container; truncating it below its directory leaves the magic readable but the size fields inconsistent. The decoder refuses with status 1 and reason 3 (directory_malformed) before any table is built.
observe: The derivation is a 40-byte prefix of the real packed carrier.
The truncated load returns status 1, reason 3.
The full carrier still loads at status 0.
Frames come from the full carrier, not from a fallback.
